name: Veterinary Hospital Señor Dog´s
address: Calle Aurelio Luis Gallardo 725 José María Vigil, Av Adolfo López Mateos Nte, Ladron De Guevara, 44650 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
reviews_preview: This is a very well established practice that obviously does not need new patients, as they made it very clear to me today. In addition to be severely overpriced (100 dollars for a visual exam that lasted 5 minutes and a certificate), customer service is substandard. Yesterday, a few hours after making an appointment for two of my three pups, I called in the late afternoon to confirm the time (I had not written it down). It turned down that the person who picked up the phone the first time had failed to schedule the appointment, since it wasn’t in their records, so it’s a good thing I called a second time. At that time (nearly the end of the business day) they had plenty of open spots. This is relevant because this morning I detected a very concerning lump on my third pup, that did not have an appointment. I took her with me to the practice, in the hope that, in addition to the exam made to the two that did have an appointment at 10:00am, someone could quickly check the lump to either give me peace of mind, or trigger prompt action. Aaron, the guy at the front desk (the same one that failed to schedule my pups the first time), refused to show any compassion or willingness to help. He did not even bother to see the schedule or make any inquiries with someone of higher authority, to see if there might be a chance to arrange that someone (they have a huge staff) quickly checked the lump.  I was appalled by the double standard and also the absolute lack of interest in helping out an animal  that may have something very serious. Aaron treated me in a condescending and patronizing way, with arrogance and absolute inflexibility that is altogether inconsistent with his own incompetence. Did I mention a staff member saw me arrive with two pups and no free hands to open the door, and passed by with out helping me? Frankly this is no way to treat people. I am only giving them two stars because the technician was competent.   I was looking for a new vet, it certainly will NOT be Dr Dogs. Watch out Mr Dog. You might not need new patients now, but if you go on like this, you might loose them all. | Vet Daniela Caldron save our rescue pup from distemper. They gave him excelent care when he had to be admitted to the overnight unit. They also understand how close we are to our pets and vise versa. They allow you to bring in homemade food if the pet isn't eating and something that smells like you to put in their cage. All this helps your pet get well faster. Or in our case saved his life. | Great team and good doctors!
